about_the_game:
Spring is here, start your urban romance life!

Official QQ Group: 864879210

About Us:
We are R.Y.Love♂! Creating a highly free urban life simulation.
Freely explore venues, romance various girls, and trigger events.

Gameplay:
Play as an urban male developing relationships with girls of different professions.

Girl Characters:
[April Version] (~1 storyline)
Construction worker, Masseuse, Sakura model, Street racer, Prison guard

[March Version] (~2 storylines)
Housewife, Receptionist, Mall girl, Convenience store clerk, Librarian

[Early Version] (3+ storylines, phone dating available)
Nurse, Lawyer, Childhood friend (fitness girl), Idol trainee, Company owner

Features:
● Open-world exploration with functional buildings
● 15+ romanceable girls with unique stories (ongoing updates)
● Character-specific minigames to boost stats and relationships

Note:
Early access version with weekly updates - stay tuned!
